'''Tunneler''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Tunneler}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bite
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Burrow
|Intent = Buff, Defend
|Effect = Gains {{BD2|Burrowed}} and (32;{{Asc2|8|37}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Burrowed, Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Attack from Below
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (23;{{Asc2|9|26}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Emerging Strike
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = {{KW2|Stunned}}. Does nothing this turn.
|GivesToEnemy = Stunned
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Tunneler|Bite}}, then uses {{Int2|Tunneler|Burrow}}. While burrowed, uses {{Int2|Tunneler|Attack from Below}} every turn.

If its {{KW2|Block}} is fully broken while burrowed, it uses {{Int2|Tunneler|Emerging Strike}}, then starts the cycle over with {{Int2|Tunneler|Bite}}.
